settings.daoris.toolHome.what: Folders that Daoris's sessions left in your own Claude Code home. A folder is listed only where its name is exactly a working folder in which one of Daoris's own session records shows a session ran; folders of your own work are never listed.
settings.daoris.toolHome.listWhy.records: Daoris's session records could not be read, and with no record of a session there, nothing is listed.
settings.daoris.toolHome.listWhy.linked: A link lies on the way to that home, so nothing in it is listed.
settings.daoris.toolHome.listWhy.relativ: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is a relative path, so it is not taken for your own home.
settings.daoris.toolHome.listWhy.inside-: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR names a place inside Daoris's own folder, which is a Daoris account and not your own home.
settings.daoris.toolHome.listWhy.no-tool: No own home is named here, so nothing is listed.
settings.daoris.toolHome.listWhy.no-home: There is no Daoris home, so nothing is listed.
settings.daoris.toolHome.listWhy.unread: That home's folders could not be read, so nothing is listed.
settings.daoris.toolHome.keeps.session: still in use: a session of Daoris's is live or waiting
settings.daoris.toolHome.keeps.resumable: still in use: a conversation that began here goes on here
settings.daoris.toolHome.keeps.record-un: may be in use: its conversation record could not be read
settings.daoris.toolHome.byHand: Daoris does not remove these yet. You can delete one by hand; leave any marked as in use.
settings.daoris.toolHome.left: Left out: {{count}}, whose names could not be proven Daoris's.
settings.daoris.toolHome.caseFolded: This home's folders ignore case, so names are compared that way.
settings.daoris.toolHome.none: Nothing of Daoris's is left there.
settings.daoris.toolHome.absent: That home keeps no folders for past sessions, so nothing of Daoris's is left there.

settings.daoris.downloads.listWhy.no-hom: There is no Daoris home, so nothing is listed.
settings.daoris.downloads.listWhy.twice: Both the old and the new place hold downloads, so nothing is listed until one of them is moved.
settings.daoris.downloads.keeps.pinnedBo: kept: pinned on this machine and by the {{workspaces}} workspace
settings.daoris.downloads.keeps.named: kept: {{file}} names a file inside it
settings.daoris.downloads.keeps.unread: kept: {{file}} cannot be read, so what uses it is not known
settings.daoris.downloads.keeps.recent: kept: downloaded within the hour, so a pin may be on its way
settings.daoris.downloads.keeps.in-use: kept: a program is running from it
settings.daoris.downloads.allKept: Every version here is in use, so nothing can be removed.
